mentions.name: gestures-apps
mentions.description: A framework for building two-player online browser games with webcam-based gesture controls, covering all aspects including hand tracking, UI, networking, and game state.
mentions.problem: There was no existing framework that covers all aspects of this kind of webcam-gesture browser game (hand tracking, UI, networking, game state).
mentions.source_excerpt:
Turns out, there isn’t a framework for these kinds of things that covers all aspects (hand tracking, UI, networking, game state), so I built it:

https://github.com/manuelkiessling/gestures-apps
